definitions.explanation: Moisture that forms on surfaces at night.

examples.english: Dew has formed on the grass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝露|あさつゆ}→朝露：08012_asatsuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{濡|ぬ}れた→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{綺麗|きれい}→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だった。
examples.english: The flowers wet with morning dew were beautiful.
On autumn mornings, there's a lot of dew, and the grass and flowers in the garden are often wet.

examples.japanese: {露|つゆ}⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{疑|うたが}わない→疑う：01889_utagau⟧。
examples.english: I don't doubt it in the slightest.
examples.notes: {露|つゆ}⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ means 'not even the tiniest bit.'

examples.japanese: そんな⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{露|つゆ}⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{知|し}らなかった→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: I didn't know anything about that at all.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ついている⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{露|つゆ}⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{思|おも}わなかった→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I never suspected in the slightest that he was lying, so I was shocked when I heard the truth.

notes:
{露|つゆ} means dew—water droplets that form on surfaces overnight.

WATCH OUT:
{露|つゆ} (dew) and ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧ (rainy season) have the same pronunciation but different kanji and meanings.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {露|つゆ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: dew forms/falls
- {露|つゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{濡|ぬ}れる→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧: to get wet with dew

USAGE:
{露|つゆ}⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ means 'not even a tiny bit':
- {露|つゆ}⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧: I don't know at all
- {露|つゆ}⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{疑|うたが}わない→疑う：01889_utagau⟧: I don't doubt in the slightest

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{朝露|あさつゆ}→朝露：08012_asatsuyu⟧: morning dew
- ⟦{露天|ろてん}→露天：14668_roten⟧: open-air, outdoor
- ⟦{露天|ろてん}→露天：14668_roten⟧⟦{風呂|ぶろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧: outdoor bath

LITERARY NOTE:
Dew is a classic image in Japanese poetry (⟦{和歌|わか}→和歌：05230_waka⟧, ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧), symbolizing transience and the fleeting nature of life.
